standings.name: A Lamp Left Burning
notes: The Storybook: A Lamp Left Burning gives the panel the most fairy-tale shape of all: a lamp kept lit for a return, so the name holds a waiting, a turn and a promised end.

lives.hedge-witch: A lamp left burning in the garden: warm, tended, cozy as a kitchen.
lives.storybook: A lamp left burning: a tale's suspense, a return promised before the last page.
lives.nutcracker: a lamp left burning for someone coming home: a faithful light keeping watch
lives.open-source-enthusiast: a lamp left lit for whoever comes after, to build by
lives.enchanted-workshop: A lamp left so the tools can finish their night's work unattended.

lives.hedge-witch: A hearth is cozy and home-made; glass is the slick, cold part I guard against.
lives.storybook: Where old tales are told: the hearth, the place a story begins.
lives.nutcracker: a hearth warm inside cold glass: a heart kept inside a made thing
lives.open-source-enthusiast: glass you can see through, and a shared hearth everyone gathers round
lives.enchanted-workshop: A workshop hearth where glass is fired like cloisonné enamel, tools at work.

standings.name: The Night Ballet
notes: The Nutcracker: The Night Ballet carries the Nutcracker's midnight, when toys wake and dance, which is the guardian's whole idea in one phrase, and a jury drawn from it reads as a company of living things rather than cold machines.
The Enchanted Workshop: The Night Ballet puts the Sorcerer's Apprentice's brooms in motion by night, so the tools visibly do their work as a dance, which is the Enchanted Workshop's whole creed.

lives.storybook: A ballet has acts: a beginning, middle and end, told in movement.
lives.nutcracker: toys that come alive at midnight in the Nutcracker's dance
lives.open-source-enthusiast: faint: a dance handed down from teacher to dancer
lives.enchanted-workshop: In a night workshop, brooms dance: the tools move, and the moving is their work.

standings.name: A Herbarium of Nights
notes: The Hedge Witch: A Herbarium of Nights is best because it names the herbal touchstone itself and keeps Medea's night-worked craft of pressed herbs.

The Open Source Enthusiast: A Herbarium of Nights comes first because its specimens carry their collectors' names and stay open for anyone to study and build on, while The Glass Hearth is a warm second.

lives.hedge-witch: Herbarium: pressed herbs and garden almanacs, kept by night, the herbal touchstone.
lives.storybook: A herbarium is a bound book of pressed pages, a story kept by night.
lives.open-source-enthusiast: specimens labeled with their collectors, kept open for anyone to study

lives.hedge-witch: Lamplight and night, cozy at a kitchen table; the music is not herbal.
lives.storybook: Reading by lamplight: a quiet night with one book open.
lives.nutcracker: midnight by lamplight, the hour the wooden soldier wakes and keeps his watch
lives.open-source-enthusiast: faint: a form earlier hands began and later hands carried on
lives.enchanted-workshop: Night work by one lamp: tools labor on in its warm light.

lives.hedge-witch: Pressed flowers and slow hours: a herbal pressing, grown and kept by hand.
lives.storybook: Pressed hours: a day turned like a page, from first light to closing.
lives.nutcracker: hours kept as a clock keeps them; a mechanism's patient time, as Gabriadze's tower
lives.enchanted-workshop: Hours pressed into work: a press, a tool, doing its job in plain sight.

lives.hedge-witch: A courtyard, a garden lit by hand-made lanterns: grown and cozy.
lives.storybook: Lanterns in a courtyard: a gathering place where stories are shared.
lives.nutcracker: lanterns hung and lit by hand in a courtyard; warm, but no mechanism
lives.open-source-enthusiast: a courtyard is shared ground, with lanterns lit for every passer-by
lives.enchanted-workshop: Lanterns in a workshop courtyard: the craftsman's tools, lit to work by.

lives.hedge-witch: A fairy ring of dancers: folk, grown in a circle like mushrooms.
lives.storybook: absent; a circle has no beginning or end, the opposite of a story's shape.
lives.nutcracker: a ring of dancers turning like wound-up toys; faint, but toy-like
lives.open-source-enthusiast: a circle where everyone holds hands and learns the steps from those before
lives.enchanted-workshop: The brooms keep time in a ring; the dance is the tools' own work.

lives.hedge-witch: absent; its hush is the cold stillness I guard against.
lives.storybook: Keeping watch from dusk to dawn: a night with a start and an end.
lives.nutcracker: a watch kept through the night to protect someone: the soldier waking at midnight
lives.open-source-enthusiast: clear as glass, a watch kept so the work can be inspected

lives.storybook: Pulse and line: ink drawn in a line across paper, one stroke after another.
lives.nutcracker: a heartbeat drawn as a line: a steady ticking given a heart
lives.enchanted-workshop: A machine's pulse and a brush's line: tools with a heartbeat, visibly at work.

lives.hedge-witch: Warm light on a painting; no herb, moss or grown thing.
lives.storybook: Light on a picture: a single page lit, as in a picture book.
lives.nutcracker: a fixture that serves the picture, faintly; a lamp tending a painting
lives.open-source-enthusiast: faint: a light over a picture, for pictures the library may show freely

lives.hedge-witch: absent; glass is slick and cold, though a choir is a voice.
lives.storybook: A choir carries one tale through many voices, a song with a shape.
lives.nutcracker: a choir of glass that sings when struck, like a bell an angel rings
lives.open-source-enthusiast: many voices sung together, each credited, the whole open to hearing
lives.enchanted-workshop: Partly: the Apprentice's music sung in glass, though no tool is seen at work.

lives.hedge-witch: Slant light across a garden bed: the telling is slant, the herbs implied.
lives.storybook: A tale told slant, by indirection, revealed a little at a time.

lives.hedge-witch: Garden walls, moss grown quietly over them; only faintly herbal.

standings.name: Stone and Glass
vetoed: The Hedge Witch: The name is made only of slick, cold, sterile materials, the very things this guardian guards against.

lives.hedge-witch: absent; stone and glass are the cold, sterile materials I guard against.
lives.storybook: absent; stone lasts but holds no turning page.
lives.open-source-enthusiast: stone foundations others laid, and glass you can see through
lives.enchanted-workshop: Tbilisi workshop materials, carved stone and fired glass; no tool shown at work.
